definitions.gloss: light spending; small in-app payments (gaming slang)
definitions.explanation: Spending only small amounts of real money on in-game or in-app purchases. Contrasts with {無|む}{課金|かきん} (spending nothing) and {重|じゅう}{課金|かきん} (heavy spending).

examples.japanese: {微|び}{課金|かきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんでいる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoy the game with only light spending.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{微|び}{課金|かきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧だ。
examples.english: I only spend a little each month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無|む}{課金|かきん}→無課金：19851_mukakin⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{微|び}{課金|かきん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Rather than spending nothing, I gather strong characters little by little with small payments.

notes:
A gaming and app slang term: {微|び} (slight) + ⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧ (paying, being charged). Describes a player who spends only small sums on microtransactions.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{無|む}{課金|かきん}→無課金：19851_mukakin⟧: playing without spending any money
- {重|じゅう}⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧: heavy spending
- {廃|はい}⟦{課金|かきん}→課金：08388_kakin⟧: extreme, excessive spending
- ⟦{課金|かきん}する→課金する：23205_kakinsuru⟧: to pay for in-app content
